---
title: "American Birds"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)

sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1e0eL4NFmGThSgUOGeWmG45urZGSrfKUgX-94tiZ6j6A/edit#gid=1253615536"

# Columns by position: C = value of X, E = estimated % of US bird species in CA
birds <- read_sheet(sheet_url) |>
  select(x = 3, ca_pct = 5) |>
  mutate(x = factor(x, levels = c(50, 70)),
         ca_pct = as.numeric(ca_pct))
```

## Visualize

```{r}
ggplot(birds, aes(x = x, y = ca_pct)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0) +
  labs(x = "X",
       y = "What percentage of US bird species do you think\nare found in California?") +
  theme_bw(18)
```

## Linear regression

```{r}
birds_lm <- lm(ca_pct ~ x, data = birds)
summary(birds_lm)
```
